t: Milwaukee Tri-Lobe mixed screwdriver set comprises a comprehensive 12-piece collection designed for professional screwdriving tasks. The versatile set is ideal for electricians, plumbers, and general builders undertaking various installation and repair jobs. Each screwdriver features a comfortable Tri-Lobe handle, optimised for maximum comfort and high torque applications, with reduced hand fatigue during prolonged use. Hardened magnetic tips ensure maximum durability and secure fastener retention, while wrench-ready shanks provide extra leverage when needed. Bit types are clearly marked on each cap for quick identification and increased efficiency on the jobsite. A lanyard hole allows for easy attachment to a safety system, enhancing workplace security.
b: Contents: PH0 x 75, PH1 x 100, PH2 x 125, PZ0 x 75, PZ1 x 100, PZ2 x 125, SL2.5 x 75, SL4 x 100, SL5.5 x 125, SL6.5 x 45, SL6.5 x 125 and SL8 x 150mm.
